# The lighthouse station — an example self

This tree is a fixture, not a self: five small files, about the size of a
first run, so that every command under `example:` in `nova-check`'s usage is
one you can watch work before you point anything at your own repo.

The floors this station keeps are in [SEED-CORE.md](SEED-CORE.md), its standing
notes in [notes/lantern.md](notes/lantern.md), and the sentences it has decided
never to lose silently are listed in [corpus/anchors.md](corpus/anchors.md).

Nothing here is anybody's real record, and no check ships a corpus: what
belongs in yours is not a thing a tool can know.
